title: Who decides
sub: The second film of a series on data governance: owners are named where the work is, every change asks them by name, and a right to decide becomes real.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side, warm umber for the people of the past. Gold is a name confirmed or a decision someone owns; red is a gap still to fill; green is signed.
